Game Overview

At its heart, Trap Dungeon is a platformer game about enter a sinister dungeon where every room is a cunning puzzle. Navigate deadly traps, face unexpected challenges, and engage with mysterious NPCs. Precision and quick thinking are your only allies in this relentless platformer. Survive at your peril—one misstep leads to instant death. Are you the chosen one?
